taxonomy.note: Current Kew accepts the species. Kew folds var. megacanthum into Cirsium horridulum.

target_zone_range.evidence_basis: Hays — Flora of Purola Preserve documents Cirsium horridulum. Williamson — University of Texas Williamson County vascular flora documents Cirsium horridulum var. horridulum, which current Kew treats within C. horridulum.
target_zone_range.blocking_issue: Need one more exact native target-zone county.
target_zone_range.guardrail: Broad Texas/eastern-U.S. nativity and non-target Lee County records are not converted into a third target-zone county.

morphology.look_here_first: The head is almost armored by foliage: upper leaves/bracts become densely comb-spined around the developing capitulum. The plant is extremely spiny, often cobwebby-woolly, with white to yellow, pink, or purple florets.
diagnostic_traits: upper leaves/bracts densely spiny and crowding around heads
